description:
Dr Jordan Peterson is a world-renowned former Professor of Psychology at the University of Toronto, and co-founder of the online education platform Peterson Academy. He is the author of bestselling books such as, ‘12 Rules for Life: An Antidote to Chaos’ and ‘We Who Wrestle With God: Perceptions of the Divine’.

02:30 The World Has Become Fractionated
05:23 Where Do We Find Ourselves Without Community?
08:41 How Do We Address Individualism in a Self-Centered Society?
15:21 Do Many People Have a Clear Ultimate Aim?
16:17 What Movie Character Would Jordan Be?
18:00 Does It Bother You When People Attack Your Reputation?
20:39 What Do You Do When You Face Tough Times?
23:47 Why You Must Speak Your Mind
29:00 Why Spend 90 Minutes a Week Listening to Your Partner?
32:26 How Do You Resolve Years of Disputes?

46:27 The Rise of Sexlessness
49:03 Why Does No Sex Before Marriage Lead to Better Outcomes?
52:19 The Purpose of Marriage vs Relationships
01:01:21 Is Porn a Bad Thing?
01:06:10 Why Doesn't Porn Feel Good to People?
01:10:06 The Effects of Pornography on You
01:12:35 AI Girlfriends
01:16:33 How to Overcome Weaknesses
01:21:14 Staying True to Your Principles
01:27:08 What to Say to People Struggling With Discipline
01:31:27 What Is Self-Belief?
01:34:47 Young Men on the Search for Religion
01:38:58 Was the Bible Just One Person's Opinion?
01:40:07 How Do You Believe We Got Here?
01:43:42 Should We Create Our Own Set of Rules?

02:06:09 Life Isn't Fair, Is It?
02:12:28 Staying True to Who You Are
02:18:24 What Losing Someone Teaches You About Life
